'''Jonox Forb''' was the leader of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] group that occupied the natural ice [[Cave/Legends|caves]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] that would later be used as the template by the [[Alliance Corps of Engineers/Legends|Alliance Corps of Engineers]] to construct [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]]. Dubbing [[Gender/Legends|his]] hidden fortress [[Snowflake Base]], he appreciated the close proximity of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].

When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] was researching the planets caves, he discovered Forb's journals in an abandoned [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] cave.
